summary: Fix Markup.striptags so comments are removed before collapsing whitespace. This prevents leftover spaces when comments are removed (e.g. 'x <!-- comment -->' -> 'x' instead of 'x '). Added a regression test for the reported case.
risks: Low. The change only reorders the whitespace collapsing to occur after comment and tag removal in striptags. Behavior of unescape remains unchanged. There is a small risk of changing whitespace normalization in edge cases where tags/comments interact with whitespace, but this aligns with historical behavior and the documented intent to remove tags then normalize whitespace.
warning: LLM patch draft. Not applied, tested, or approved. Review before Docker execution.
